requirements.requirement: Timeout, no route, refused port, wrong password and busy host have correct distinct outcomes

evidence.environment: RG Mac Studio, Xcode 26.6, iPhone 17 Pro simulator iOS 26.5; isolated fixture host on a free loopback port; MacBook CLT for the classifier tests
evidence.result: Five distinct outcomes, each with a UI capture and a control transcript. Wrong password: 'Password Not Accepted' after trust, no Try Again (← error {code:authentication}). Refused loopback port: 'Portlight Host Isn’t Listening', no trust sheet, Try Again offered. Busy host (the test holds the fixture's single viewer slot with its own pinned, authenticated viewer): 'Another Viewer Is Connected' after trust (← error {code:busy}); once that viewer left, Try Again connected with the pin kept. Silent host (a loopback listener that accepts TCP and never answers TLS): 'The Computer Didn’t Answer' at the 10 s connect deadline, no hello sent (· failed timedOut). No route ([100::1], the IPv6 discard prefix; the kernel says EHOSTUNREACH on this Mac): 'Can’t Reach the Computer', no hello sent (· closed noRoute). Probing no-route first showed it misreported as 'No Network Connection', because URLSession returns a bare -1009. It was fixed by classifying with the device's own network status (DeviceNetworkMonitor); 3 new classifier tests, 695/695 on macOS. All 6 FixtureSessionTests passed; the test-e2e transcript checks passed; no password in the 9 evidence files checked.

The Hold Left latch no longer shows as held (heldInputIsReleasedOnTheWire, 3 cases). A mode switch releases buttons and modifiers and clears the latches (SessionInputTests.swift:91). requirements.requirement: Explicit Type Pasted Text uses native paste intent and UTF-8-safe chunks; no clipboard polling

evidence.environment: SwiftPM on both Macs (720 tests); scripts/test-integration 22/22; source inspection
evidence.result: Automated part passes.
